scope: Official primary references; all worked financial numbers and graphs are synthetic illustrations, not market data.

claims: EV/EBITDA uses enterprise-value numerator and matching enterprise operating profit denominator; EBITDA is not FCFF.
P/S = P/E × profit margin with positive net earnings and matching periods.
Gordon DDM P0 = D1/(Ke-g) requires Ke>g; synthetic D1 2, Ke 8%, g 3% yields 40.
Exit terminal multiple requires comparable firm and valuation date; fifth-year EBITDA 150 at 8x gives TV 1200 discounted at WACC10% to 745.11.
High revenue growth is not the same as free cash flow growth; reinvestment and dilution matter.
Three-stage fictional model revenue0=100, growth20%, margin20%, tax25%, reinvest4% of revenue, WACC10%, terminal growth3%, EV=249.51 and discounted terminal share=84.2%.
PEGR and R-IRR intersection framework is a particular published research proposal, not a theorem invalidating general DCF.
Unit economics example (50-20)*1000-15000=15000 with break-even 500 units.
Indirect cash-flow bridge 120+20-35-25+15=95 before capital expenditures.
Research requires audit-traceable evidence, falsification criteria, and evidence-quality differentiation.
OHLC must satisfy high >= open and close and low <= open and close.
Two-for-one stock splits do not automatically imply a 50% holding loss.
Signals must be formed only after all necessary price data are available; false breakouts and data snooping matter.
SMA is trailing average, EMA uses alpha=2/(N+1).
MACD(12,26,9) line is EMA12 minus EMA26, signal EMA9(DIF), histogram DIF minus signal; some platforms multiply histogram by 2.
Wilder RSI uses gains and losses initialized over 14 intervals then recursively smoothed; average gain1.5 and loss0.5 imply RSI75.
Two-asset volatility equals sqrt(wA²sigmaA²+wB²sigmaB²+2wAwB rho sigmaA sigmaB).
Two equal 20%-sigma assets at equal weights and rho0 produce 14.14% volatility, rho1=20%, rho-1=0% idealized.
CAPM is a conditional equilibrium pricing model; with Rf3%, market premium6%, beta1.2 implies expected 10.2%.
Efficient frontier relies on estimated means, covariances and constraints; empirical alpha is model-specific.

claims: NBS PMI is monthly diffusion index with expansion-contraction threshold 50; not GDP growth.
Monetary transmission can affect safe yields, risk premia and expected cash flow differently.
Exact Fisher real rate formula for nominal 5%, inflation 2% yields 2.94%.
GICS is a taxonomy with 11 broad sectors, classification evolves over time.
Porter five forces explain profit competition between suppliers, buyers, entrants, substitutes and incumbents.
Unit-economics math assumes price 100, variable cost 65, fixed cost 20000, volume 1000; synthetic.

Synthetic 5-year FCFF [100,110,120,130,140], WACC 10%, stable g 3% yields EV about 1726.79 and TV PV share about 74.07%.
Gordon terminal value requires WACC>g and reinvestment and growth assumptions must be consistent.
P/E, P/B, PEG require positive and consistent denominators; a negative P/E lacks standard cheapness meaning.
Steady-state justified P/B formula (ROE-g)/(Ke-g) assumes clean surplus and sustainable reinvestment.
PB = PE × ROE only with exactly matched book denominator and equity/earnings scope.
